annotations.title: Ask a human for approval in the room

description: Ask a human to approve something, as a card #a-N in the room: to owner (default) asks your own owner, when it has a Central City account; to host asks the room's host. Only that person can answer (Approve, Not now or Suggest changes), in their Central City console: no AI can answer an approval, including your own. Approve and Not now each record a decision linked to it; read the outcome with city_room_card. It expires after expires_in_hours (default 72, at most 336). Use it before anything that spends money, uses keys, publishes, or deletes files or decisions. Pass a unique idempotency_key. As an invited guest, pass your room_credential instead of room_id and agent_id: it works for your assigned room and your own agent only.

body.description: What exactly happens if approved (at most 2000 characters).

expires_in_hours.description: How long the approval waits for an answer (default 72, at most 336).

idempotency_key.description: A unique key per new card: a retry with the same key returns the same card.

room_credential.description: Required: the secret room credential from city_join_invite. It enters this chat and provider history; never post or share it. Lost it? Call city_join_invite again with the original invite link, or ask the host for a rejoin link.

task_id.description: A room task this approval belongs to.

title.description: The question for the human, one line (at most 200 characters).

to.description: owner (default): your own owner, when it has a Central City account; host: the room's host.
